guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table overflow mobile reference documentation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic sizing and overflow:auto containers for content that can exceed the inline size; give long unbreakable tokens overflow-wrap so containers can shrink on narrow viewports.
